expert_ordering.definition: Pairs of distinct actually listened windows with different expert scores. Reversed pair: prediction order is opposite to expert. Equal expert scores impose no order. Model ties are reported separately and count as half an error in order_error_percent. Exact floating-point equality defines model ties. No cluster averaging is used.

limitations: TEST has been inspected in earlier experiments; this is a fixed comparative benchmark, not new independent evidence.
Original HuBERT previously saw some recordings under historical admin labels; its evaluation is not guaranteed independent of its pretraining/fine-tuning.
Acoustic groups and duplicate grouping do not prove speaker identity independence.
Expert judgments define one expert perceptual scale; other rater scales remain unaligned.
TRAIN and weak propagated corpus scores cannot establish generalization.
Paired bootstrap uses coarse acoustic groups and is approximate; repeated hypothesis search is not accounted for.
Original student selected by frozen VAL teacher fidelity among ECAPA256; expert student is previously selected_mini_human. No model was chosen using this comparison TEST.
CPU timing uses GPU host CPU with decoded input and frontend included; production bot CPU, network, queues and decoding can differ.
Evaluation uses listened five-second windows with per-window peak normalization; bot aggregation and whole-recording normalization can produce different scores.

coverage.preprocessing: exact start frame, mono, pad before resampling, PCM16 listener roundtrip, peak-normalize per 5s
